notes.title: Gorit - Steam Next Fest Livestream
notes.notes:
The Steam Next Fest livestream is a great opportunity to interact with the developer. 

I will be streaming 3 playtroughs of the demo, one with each main character. Watch me play, ask me anything you want and enjoy my thoughts on the soon comming game "Gorit".

What's next for my game? What other features will it include? How long will the story be? All of these questions and much more will be answered in the livestream!
